title: Certify current P104 precision with additive COPY and reset residuals
body:
The current PR5811 word now has a source-bound precision lemma which permits additive COPY and bounded reset residuals. The exact error transition retains destination error at COPY. The complete 25,984-event, 799-coordinate word still satisfies sufficient guards of **26 bits for all prefixes, 23 for final public fields, and 22 for final owned residuals**.

The checker verifies the full arbitrary-input endpoint, all final signed error coefficients with a separate transposed program, prefix maxima, literal attaining input and independent-defect fixtures, and six semantic rejection controls. A concrete reset/COPY fixture refutes a naive overwrite extension. It does not refute PR5819, whose stated contract assumes exact resets.

Registered Python 3.12 replay, committed-byte/mode checks, source-corruption rejection, and read-only Git-free optimized replay pass. The two source heads are pinned; the prior analysis is unchanged, and every edit in the adapted module is declared and checked. Full-history preflight was not run in the shallow checkout. Hosted replay and independent scientific review remain pending.

These are sufficient completed-operation bounds, not optimal physical precision. Native unitary gauges remain a premise. Thirty of the 31 CLEAR events erase nonzero ideal data. The package does not implement or price those resets, prove exact owned zero return, admit the native child, or discharge the compiler, precision-tape or analytic assumptions. No new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed.

[Canonical claim and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2750#discussioncomment-19209183). Source PR5811: `33d7760d0a6fea6394aefd014eea68f0af02a92e`; precision predecessor PR5819: `05c15af1393f7d737fa316b507638a50f20d4925`. Credit Adam Gall, ywz65, PR2878, PR5819, Mason Hale/PR5811 and all retained P104 source authors. Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.

CI dependency: unchanged test-only PR5761 commit `ba8a9e640e1983f3c29993fefa3f46e8ed03313a`, cherry-picked with original authorship and provenance. It separates frozen revision-7 routing fixtures from the live priority-8 catalogue and changes no research artifact or mathematical claim.


Clean-checkout source repair: the initial hosted job could not resolve pending predecessor commits. SOURCES.json now binds the exact retained input copies in this PR history; retained_predecessors preserves every original head, path, blob and SHA256 plus the retained file/archive member. Original and retained bytes were checked equal. Metadata, committed bytes/modes and declared-pin ancestry checks pass. Source bytes, mathematical assertions and scientific receipts are unchanged. The full-history preflight remains unrun in this shallow checkout. Hosted replay is queued for the new head.
